description: Bruce security toolkit UI for CardputerZero

store.summary: Bruce pentest toolkit UI — Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, RF, network and SMB tools
store.description:
Bruce-style security toolkit UI for the CardputerZero: a purple/black LVGL menu that launches Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, RF, network and SMB tooling from the device screen.

- Launches the real Linux binaries already on the device (curl, nc, iw, bluetoothctl, smbclient, responder, rtl_433, …) and streams their output to the screen, so every tool behaves exactly like its CLI.
- Category carousel, per-category tool lists, live tool-run log, and an interactive terminal (commands run in-session; a leading 'sudo ' runs as root).
- Add a tool by editing one data file (the tool catalog) — no screen code needed.
- Status bar with clock, Wi-Fi strength and battery; light/dark toggle and accent theme picker.

⚠️ For authorized security testing, CTF and research only. Several menu entries (Responder, port scans, packet capture) are only legal against systems you own or have written permission to test.
